quote: On April 23, 2025, the Board of Directors of Syngene recommended a final dividend of Rs. 1.25 per equity share of Rs. 10/-. The proposed dividend is subject to the approval of the shareholders of Syngene in its Annual General Meeting.

topic: Biocon proposed final dividend of Rs. 0.50, Rs. 600 million
quote: On May 08, 2025, the Board of Directors of the Company recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share of Rs. 5/-.each amounting to Rs. 600. The proposed dividend is subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company in its Annual General Meeting.

topic: Post year-end approval to raise funds up to Rs 45,000 million
quote: The Board of Directors at its meeting held on April 23, 2025, has approved raising of funds by the Company by way of issuance of any instrument or securities for an aggregate amount of upto Rs 45,000, in one or more tranches to meet certain financial commitments and / or debt obligations of the Company and its subsidiary, Biocon Biologics Limited and/ or for other purposes as determined by the Board.
